Level 2 Spiders wander around the room unpredictably and crawl towards Isaac if he is nearby. They combine the abilities of both the normal Spider and the Trite, though unlike the Trite, they do not leap as often and not as far.

Gallery

  • Sketches of monsters for the Binding of Isaac: Rebirth, including the Lvl2 Spider in the second square of the third row.

Trivia

  • Ticking Spiders used to deal one heart of damage on contact until v1.031. Their collision damage now does half a heart.
